t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):

def colper(a):
    H,W=a.shape; p=None
    for p_ in range(1,W):
        if all(a[r][c]==a[r][c+p_] for r in range(H) for c in range(W-p_)):
            p=p_; break
    return p

print(colper(a1))
def f(a,p):
    H,W=a.shape; R=[[a[r][(j+W)%p] for j in range(W)] for r in range(H)]
    return np.hstack([a,np.array(R)])
print('pair1:',np.array_equal(f(a1,6),b1))
print('pair2:',np.array_equal(f(a2,3),b2))
test=np.array(G['Test input'])
p=colper(test)
print('test p:',p)
out=f(test,p).tolist()
print(json.dumps(out))
